title: Decision on the Key Policy Rate of the National Bank of Serbia
text:
Pursuant to Article 14, paragraph 3 and Article 41, paragraph 1 of the Law on the
National Bank of Serbia (RS Official Gazette, Nos 72/2003, 55/2004, 85/2005 – other
law, 44/2010, 76/2012, 106/2012, 14/2015, 40/2015 ‒ Constitutional Court decision and
44/2018), the Executive Board of the National Bank of Serbia hereby issues the
following
DECISION
ON THE KEY POLICY RATE
OF THE NATIONAL BANK OF SERBIA
1. The key policy rate of the National Bank of Serbia is hereby set at 5.75% p.a.
2. On the day of effectiveness of this Decision, the Decision on the Key Policy Rate of the
National Bank of Serbia (NBS Executive Board No 11 of 11 July 2024) shall cease to be
valid.
3. This Decision shall be published on the National Bank of Serbia’s website and shall
take immediate effect.
NBS Executive Board No 51 Chairperson
12 September 2024
NBS Executive Board
Belgrade
Governor
National Bank of Serbia
Dr Jorgovanka Tabaković, sign.
